data_gaps.reason: Page 25 states shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain (回避) at the shareholders' meeting, but the schema leaf concerns bondholder abstention; the text addresses shareholder abstention, so the boolean cannot be resolved from these pages.

Page 26 states the revised conversion price shall not be below the latest audited net asset per share and par value, but the enum asks whether downward revision below net asset is prohibited by contract; the clause addresses the revised price floor, not an explicit below-net-asset contract position.

Page 26 states the revised conversion price shall not be lower than the latest audited net asset per share, which supports a net asset floor; however the enum PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN is not clearly resolvable without deciding whether this floor clause qualifies.

Page 26 states the revised conversion price shall not be lower than the stock par value, which supports a par value floor; however the enum PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN is not clearly resolvable without deciding whether this floor clause qualifies.
Page 27 states the closing price condition is any consecutive 30 trading days, but the put observation_window integer is not separately stated as a distinct observation window term.
Page 27 states the closing price is below 70% of the current conversion price for any consecutive 30 trading days; the required_days integer is not separately stated.
Page 27 states the closing price is below 70% of the current conversion price, but the put trigger_ratio is not separately stated as a ratio term distinct from the 70% threshold.

The down-revision clause on pages 25-26 describes recalculation of trading days before/after the adjustment day but does not state a distinct adjustment_day_treatment rule beyond that; no separate treatment term is expressly labeled.

Page 25 states shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain (回避) at the shareholders' meeting, but the schema leaf concerns bondholder abstention; the text addresses shareholder abstention, so the boolean cannot be resolved from these pages.

Page 26 states the revised conversion price shall not be below the latest audited net asset per share and par value, but the enum asks whether downward revision below net asset is prohibited by contract; the clause addresses the revised price floor, not an explicit below-net-asset contract position.

Page 26 states the revised conversion price shall not be lower than the latest audited net asset per share, which supports a net asset floor; however the enum PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN is not clearly resolvable without deciding whether this floor clause qualifies.

Page 26 states the revised conversion price shall not be lower than the stock par value, which supports a par value floor; however the enum PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN is not clearly resolvable without deciding whether this floor clause qualifies.
Page 27 states the closing price condition is any consecutive 30 trading days, but the put observation_window integer is not separately stated as a distinct observation window term.
Page 27 states the closing price is below 70% of the current conversion price for any consecutive 30 trading days; the required_days integer is not separately stated.
Page 27 states the closing price is below 70% of the current conversion price, but the put trigger_ratio is not separately stated as a ratio term distinct from the 70% threshold.
Page 26-27 states any consecutive 30 trading days with at least 15 trading days at or above 130% of the current conversion price; the redemption observation_window integer is not separately stated.
Page 26-27 states at least 15 trading days within any consecutive 30 trading days; the redemption required_days integer is not separately stated.
Page 26-27 states the closing price is not less than 130% of the current conversion price, but the redemption trigger_ratio is not separately stated as a ratio term distinct from the 130% threshold.

Page 27 states the outstanding unconverted balance is less than RMB 30 million, but the schema requires a canonical decimal string in yuan; the text gives 3,000万元, which is 30000000 yuan, yet the threshold leaf is not separately stated as a canonical decimal string.
Page 27 provides the formula IA=B×i×t/365 for accrued interest, but the accrued_interest_redemption_rule string is not separately stated as a rule term.
Page 26 states the company will redeem all unconverted bonds at 108% of face value including final interest, but the maturity_redemption_price_rule string is not separately stated as a rule term.
Page 26 states redemption within five trading days after maturity, but the maturity_redemption_window_days integer is not separately stated as a number of days.

Page 23 states if a payment date falls on a legal holiday or rest day it is postponed to the next trading day without additional interest, but the holiday_deferral_rule string is not separately stated as a rule term.
Page 26 states the 108% redemption includes the final interest, but the boolean maturity_price_includes_final_interest is not separately stated as a boolean term.

Page 24 states the conversion period starts from the first trading day six months after the issuance completion date (2026-07-01, T+4), i.e. 2027-01-01; however the contractual_period_start date is not separately stated as a distinct term.
Page 24 states the conversion period ends on the maturity date 2032-06-24; however the period_end date is not separately stated as a distinct term.

Page 24 states the initial conversion price is not lower than the average trading price of the 20 trading days before the prospectus announcement date and the previous trading day's average trading price, but the initial_price_bases array enum values are not separately stated as an array.

evidence.excerpt:
本次发行的可转债最后两个计息年度，可转债持有人在每年回售条件首次满
足后可按上述约定条件行使回售权一次，若在首次满足回售条件而可转债持有人
未在公司届时公告的回售申报期内申报并实施回售的，该计息年度不能再行使回
售权。可转债持有人不能多次行使部分回售权。

evidence.excerpt:
若公司本次发行的可转债募集资金投资项目的实施情况与公司在募集说明
书中的承诺情况相比出现重大变化，且该变化被中国证监会或上海证券交易所认
定为改变募集资金用途的，可转债持有人享有一次以面值加上当期应计利息的价
格向公司回售其持有的全部或部分可转换公司债券的权利（当期应计利息的计算
方式参见第（十一）条赎回条款的相关内容）。可转债持有人在附加回售条件满
足后，可以在公司公告的附加回售申报期内进行回售，该次附加回售申报期内不
实施回售的，自动丧失该附加回售权。
